title: Purified Water system monitoring and controls | Aquemi
meta: Online TOC (USP <643>), uncompensated conductivity (USP <645>), alarms and divert for your Purified Water package.
headline: Water data you can defend
lead: Online instruments, alarms and divert for your Purified Water package. Quality readings are recorded and kept.
primary_cta_intent: I have a URS or a draft|Review of another document|Controls URS or functional specification

stages.d: Measure total organic carbon (TOC), conductivity and temperature online.
Runs sequences, interlocks and divert, even if every layer above fails.
Where operators see alarms, trends and sanitization status.

rows.v: Online; the uncompensated reading is the record
Water out of specification goes to drain, never to storage
rows.m: Tested at the factory and site acceptance tests (FAT, SAT)

rows.v: Return flow alarmed below the qualified minimum

blocks.h: Questions quality and IT teams ask

items.q: Can we release water on online TOC and conductivity?
items.a: Yes, for TOC and conductivity, once qualification shows online readings match point-of-use samples. Microbial counts stay laboratory tests.

items.q: Do sites outside good manufacturing practice (GMP) get the same controls?
items.a: Yes: the same instruments, alarms and records.

items.q: Do we get full access to the PLC and HMI code?
items.a: Code access and ownership are set out in your proposal. Whether the code's version and checksum are recorded at the factory acceptance test (FAT) is confirmed there too; a recorded checksum lets you show the running code is the tested code.

items.q: Our IT team allows no remote access to GMP equipment.
items.a: The system runs and records on its own, offline. It needs no connection to your network.

cta.body: An engineer replies in writing. Cost: quoted in your proposal.
